out.title: Shareholders re-appoint Sunil Vachani and Atul Lall for five years
out.summary: At 33rd AGM (28 Sep 2026), shareholders approved re-appointment of Sunil Vachani as Whole Time Director and Atul B. Lall as Managing Director, each for five years effective 5 May 2027, with remuneration.

person.name: Atul B. Lall
person.bio: Leading Dixon since foundation; 30+ years EMS experience; director on Happy Forgings, Max Estates, Aditya Infotech; ELCINA President; author of 'Gita and India Inc.'
